I ran everything read-only on the scratch copies through open_page.js: SYNC was live, no page errors, and 0 writes were blocked because none were attempted, so edit mode was never needed. No repo file changed (git status is clean under 03_GC500_Delivery_Control).

Files:
- Build script: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-fish/b3d08fad-688f-5986-9fd9-2f1442b3bb1a/scratchpad/vms23/today/build.py. It applies every exact replacement and checks each old text occurs exactly once.

Results on 19 Oct, live record:
- Every Today VMS count reads 23 total, 20 on site, 20 complete, 3 left.
- The milestone is 87% and no longer reached.
- Group card: '23 boards · 20 of 23 on site · 87% · By type VMS 20 23 · Due by this day 21 · Coming in the next 7 days 2'. VMS24 is due today with nothing recorded, so it sits in 'Due by this day'; VMS22 (21 Oct) and VMS21 (22 Oct) are the 2 coming.

- Copy A leaves Scope960 saying 'Schedule basis: 23 boards. Earlier confirmed requirement: 22 boards (01 Oct 2026)…'. That calls the register count the schedule's, and VMS stays 'provisional scope'.
- Copy B adds one more edit: Andrew's 19 Oct figure of 23 becomes the recorded requirement. VMS then reads 'Confirmed complete · 23 total' and the caption becomes 'Provisional: Fencing'. I recommend B.

record.how:
Short answer: the page lets you add the three boards as records, but that doesn't give the result Andrew wants. Only some screens move to 20 of 23. The milestone and the main VMS progress reading stay at 20 of 20 (100%), the VMS register doesn't change, and Revenue goes up by $265.47.

How the test ran: everything was read-only. The page was opened only through toolchain/harness/open_page.js on build/GC500_v10.75/GC500_Delivery_Control_hosted.html, at 1440x900, with its own cache, and it reached SYNC.status 'live'. I then switched on edit mode in the page (capability, mayWrite, SYNC.readonly=false, SYNC.level='edit', S.operator='Andrew Fisher'). I also replaced the page's save call (SYNC.db.doc) with an in-page capture, so no save ever left the browser. The harness blocked count was 0 because nothing was sent. The captured saves were added/VMS21, added/VMS22 and added/VMS24, plus branch stamps in the runs that set a branch.

I captured the page before, re-rendered it once to find lines that change by themselves (Costs had none), then called the page's own addReference(f) for each board. The fields were discipline 'Variable message signs', type 'VMS', in-day 22 Oct, 21 Oct and 19 Oct, no out-day, no asset number, and not on site. The Add tab itself is set aside on v10.75, so this is the same save that Change deliveries uses. All three keys were accepted. I then read Today, Equipment (VMS boards view, row, strip and register) and every Costs fold, plus the VMS lines on every other tab.

Four runs:
- a: keys VMS21, VMS22, VMS24 with no branch.
- b: same keys with branch STPS, then VMS24 marked on site and ticked complete in memory.
- c: the keys Change deliveries suggests for type VMS, which are T269, T270 and T271, with STPS. Costs came out identical to run b apart from the names.
- d: out-day 26 Oct. During this run the live record moved (two new running-sheet shifts, wages +$1,209.54). The page's 4-second refresh then wiped the three in-memory additions. That confirms nothing was saved. Run d's money figures are mixed with those wage changes, so only its add-only lines are reported.

One slip: I briefly wrote one helper file in the scratchpad root instead of my own folder, and deleted it straight away.

All evidence is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-fish/b3d08fad-688f-5986-9fd9-2f1442b3bb1a/scratchpad/vms23/record/: the folders out_a, out_b, out_c and out_d (B2 = before, A = after the additions, C = after VMS24 turns up; each has _today, _costs and _plant text files plus JSON), out_a/costs_diff.txt, and the scripts record_test.cjs, record_test2.cjs and record_test3.cjs.

Why it falls short:
1. A record added this way has no product. The Today milestone and work-progress reading (todayWorkMetrics840) group by product = 'VMS', so they never count the new records and stay at 20 of 20. Only the screens that count by type 'VMS' move to 23.
2. The register (vms913*) is built from the contract lines and the fixed list of VMS deliveries. A board on it can only be put on one of the deliveries in that list (T0001/T0103/T0128/T0158/T0159, plus T0169/T0170, which were deleted for good), never on a record added by hand. VMS21, VMS22 and VMS24 stay 'not named yet' on the register, even after they turn up.
3. Each new record takes the card's install labour of $88.485 (the card's 2024 labour figure of $176.97, halved). That adds $265.47 to Revenue.

1. Revenue changes. Installation Revenue (1047) gets +$265.47 of forecast: the card's install labour of $88.485 a board, which comes from the card's 2024 labour figure. This flows through Total Revenue, Gross Margin, Difference so far and every labour summary. With no branch it sits in "Shared job / allocation pending" and "no branch recorded 3". With STPS it moves costs between the branches.

2. The counts are split. Equipment and the Where-we-are panel say 20 of 23 (87%). The milestone, the category index and the VMS group heading say 20 of 20 (100%), because a hand-added record has no product, and the group card's own type row says 86.96%.

3. The register goes out of step. It can only put a board on one of its listed deliveries (T0001, T0103, T0128, T0158, T0159, and the deleted T0169/T0170), never on a record added by hand. So VMS21, VMS22 and VMS24 stay "not named yet" even after they turn up. When one arrives through its own record, Equipment counts it as "no number yet" rather than Premiair Hire. Contract lines 28, 29 and 31 name Premiair (line 31 is SUB-1101), so the company split is wrong.

4. Key clash. No technical clash: the register's boards and the job's references are stored separately, and addReference accepted the keys. But "VMS21", "VMS22" and "VMS24" would then each name two different things, a board on the register and a separate reference. Change deliveries' suggested names (T269 to T271) avoid this, give identical Costs, and use 3 digits rather than the 4-digit T0xxx pattern.

5. Contract lines 28, 29 and 31 could be counted twice. Today they are not: the hire on those lines is already in Rehire Revenue and Rehire cost ($214, $375, $375 "not on the record"), and the new records add no hire to the P&L while they have no off-hire day, or even with an out-day of 26 Oct. But once a record is on site, the onsite subtotal prices its hire from the card ($375.27 for VMS24) while line 31 stays unlinked, so the same board is priced from two places. If Andrew also books the arriving board on a VMS delivery (raising T0158's quantity, say), its hire, install, transport legs and counts are doubled: 24 ordered, and 21 of 23 plus another one.

6. Priced from the card when it shouldn't be:
- install labour $88.49 each;
- card hire of $53.61 a day with a 7-day minimum in the onsite subtotal once a board arrives;
- delivery and pickup legs held as POA (adds 6 to "rows held for allocation review", 56 → 62, and takes the VMS holds from 4 to 7; on arrival the onsite holds go from 72 to 74).
